boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost places and activities on the Iowa State campus and around Ames, including museums, public art, gardens, parks, and library rooms.

cards.title: Browse Brunnier’s Changing Exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Scheman Building · Iowa State University
cards.notes: Meet inside the Scheman Building and browse the changing exhibitions together; confirm current gallery hours before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A free indoor art outing centered on rotating exhibitions and decorative arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Ames visitor guide identifies Brunnier Art Museum as an Iowa State University museum and states that the campus museum venues offer free admission.
cards.source_title: 2026 Guide to Ames & Iowa State University
cards.access_notes: Admission is free. Hours vary by location; check the University Museums schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Share a Slow Gallery Walk
cards.subtitle: Morrill Hall · Iowa State University
cards.notes: Walk both gallery levels at an unhurried pace, then compare one work each person would revisit before leaving Morrill Hall.
cards.short_summary: Two floors of free galleries make an easy conversation-focused campus hang.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Ames visitor guide names the Christian Petersen Art Museum among Iowa State’s museum venues and says the venues have free admission.
cards.source_title: 2026 Guide to Ames & Iowa State University
cards.access_notes: Admission is free. This indoor museum has location-specific hours, so consult the current schedule first.

cards.title: Explore Iowa State’s Historic Farm House
cards.subtitle: Central Campus · Iowa State University
cards.notes: Tour the historic rooms with a friend and use the exhibits to trace how campus life changed around Iowa State’s oldest building.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost history stop inside an 1860s National Historic Landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Ames visitor guide describes Farm House Museum as Iowa State’s oldest building and includes it among campus museums with free admission.
cards.source_title: 2026 Guide to Ames & Iowa State University
cards.access_notes: Admission is free. Check current museum hours before arriving because hours vary by venue.

cards.entity_name: Elizabeth and Byron Anderson Sculpture Garden
cards.title: Loop Through the Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: South of Morrill Hall · Iowa State University
cards.notes: Circle the outdoor garden, pause at several sculptures, and trade observations about materials, scale, and the surrounding plantings.
cards.short_summary: An always-open outdoor route pairing contemporary sculpture with garden space.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Ames visitor guide identifies Anderson Sculpture Garden as an outdoor contemporary-sculpture venue, marks it open 24/7, and states the museum venues have free admission.
cards.source_title: 2026 Guide to Ames & Iowa State University
cards.access_notes: The outdoor garden is listed as open 24/7. Choose daylight and suitable weather for easier viewing.

cards.title: Build a Self-Guided Public-Art Walk
cards.subtitle: Campus buildings and grounds · Iowa State University
cards.notes: Open the interactive collection map, choose a compact cluster of works, and take turns selecting the next artwork on the route.
cards.short_summary: A customizable free walk through Iowa State’s campuswide collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Ames visitor guide says Iowa State’s Art on Campus Collection contains more than 2,700 works across campus and directs visitors to an interactive map; it describes the museum experience as free.
cards.source_title: 2026 Guide to Ames & Iowa State University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor works require no admission. Access to works inside buildings depends on each building’s open hours.

cards.title: Take a Student Garden Break
cards.subtitle: Free admission for Iowa State students
cards.notes: Bring classmates for a walk through the outdoor gardens and indoor displays, allowing enough time to explore without rushing.
cards.short_summary: A 17-acre garden visit available without admission cost to current ISU students.
cards.evidence_claim: Reiman Gardens’ official admission page lists admission for Iowa State University students as free.
cards.access_notes: Free only for Iowa State University students; other visitors generally pay admission. Check current hours before traveling.

cards.title: Meet at a Free Shelter, Then Walk the Lake
cards.subtitle: 5205 Grand Avenue · Ames
cards.notes: Start at a free shelter, then choose one of the published lake loops for a group walk; remember that swimming is prohibited.
cards.short_summary: A shelter meetup paired with mapped lakeside walking and biking paths.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Ames lists free shelters, open green space, picnic tables, and walking and biking paths at Ada Hayden Heritage Park.
cards.source_title: Ada Hayden Heritage Park - City of Ames, Iowa
cards.access_notes: Park hours are 6 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily. Shelters are listed as free; swimming is unlawful at this park.

cards.title: Gather for Volleyball or Basketball
cards.subtitle: 3710 Hyde Avenue · Ames
cards.notes: Claim a free shelter as the meetup point, then rotate between sand volleyball, basketball, the mini-pitch, and the walking path.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost group outing with several casual recreation choices in one park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Ames lists free shelters plus sand volleyball, basketball, a mini-pitch, and a walking and biking path at Lloyd Kurtz Park.
cards.source_title: Lloyd Kurtz Park - City of Ames, Iowa
cards.access_notes: Open 6 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily. Shelter use is listed as free; bring your own ball if using a court or field.

cards.title: Plan a West Ames Park Meetup
cards.subtitle: 147 South Franklin Avenue · Ames
cards.notes: Use the free shelter as a clear meeting point, then move between the green space, basketball area, and walking path as a group.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward neighborhood meetup with shelter space and outdoor activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Ames lists free shelters, open green space, basketball, picnic tables, and a walking and biking path at Franklin Park.
cards.source_title: Franklin Park - City of Ames, Iowa
cards.access_notes: Open 6 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily. The shelter is listed as free; the city page does not list off-street parking.

cards.entity_name: Ames Public Library Meeting and Study Rooms
cards.title: Host a Free Study or Creative Session
cards.subtitle: 515 Douglas Avenue · Downtown Ames
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a study circle, writing group, or rehearsal, and assign one person to restore tables and chairs afterward.
cards.short_summary: Free public rooms support small-group work without requiring a café purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Ames Public Library states that its large meeting rooms and smaller study rooms are available for free public use.
cards.source_title: Using the Library - Ames Public Library
cards.access_notes: Use is limited to library hours. Meeting-room gatherings must be free and open to the public; reservation rules apply.

warnings: Reiman Gardens is free specifically for Iowa State University students; general public admission is normally paid.
Indoor museum and campus-building access varies by current operating schedule.
Coordinates and map URLs are null because exact values were not independently verified from the cited direct pages.
